sermon.title: No One Knows the Day, Part 2
sermon.speaker: Pastor David G. Kincer
sermon.summary: In this message Pastor David G. Kincer walks through Matthew 24, Mark 13 and Luke 21, teaching that the abomination of desolation is Jerusalem surrounded by armies and was fulfilled in AD 70, and that wars, famines and false christs are not signs of the end. He describes the real signs of Christ’s coming, says the righteous and wicked are dealt with at the same time, and closes with Jesus’ final word: repent and be ready.
sermon.transcript_source: This transcript comes from YouTube’s automatic English captions, which supply the timing and the words. Punctuation, capitalization and paragraphing were added by hand, and obvious caption errors were corrected; his wording was not rewritten. “[unclear]” marks a word or name that was not clear. Editor note: at 6:00 he says “Mark 24:15” for the abomination of desolation; the verse is Matthew 24:15 (Mark 13:14 in Mark). At 25:01 the captions have the locusts told to harm “only those with the seal of God,” where Revelation 9:4 says those who do not have the seal; both are kept as spoken. His figures (six million in the Holocaust, over a million slaughtered and 95,000 taken captive in AD 70, 400,000 cigarette deaths a year in America, fifty percent of Americans with a sexually transmitted disease, over 30 such diseases) and his statements about homosexuals, liberals, humanists and other groups are his own and are not verified here. Several spots are marked [unclear].

But if that evil servant says in his heart, ‘My master is delaying his coming,’ and begins to beat his fellow servants, and to eat and drink with the drunkards, the master of that servant will come on a day when he is not looking for him and at an hour that he is not aware of, and will cut him in two and appoint him his portion with the hypocrites. There shall be weeping and gnashing of teeth.

faqs.question: What does the word “sign” mean in Matthew 24?
faqs.answer: He says the word sign is supernatural, a miracle, so the sign of His coming is the supernatural miracle of His coming.

scriptures.text_nkjv: Now as He sat on the Mount of Olives, the disciples came to Him privately, saying, “Tell us, when will these things be? And what will be the sign of Your coming, and of the end of the age?”

faqs.question: Are wars and rumors of wars a sign of the end?
faqs.answer: He says wars and rumors of wars will deceive many, but “the end is not yet this is not a sign of the end.”

scriptures.text_nkjv: And you will hear of wars and rumors of wars. See that you are not troubled; for all these things must come to pass, but the end is not yet.

faqs.question: What does a good preacher say about who has the answer?
faqs.answer: He says a good preacher will say the Bible has the answer and Jesus is the answer, and preachers are just messengers of the Bible and Jesus Christ.

faqs.question: When does he say Jerusalem and the temple were destroyed?
faqs.answer: He says the abomination of desolation, Jerusalem surrounded by armies for the destruction of it and the temple, happened in 70 AD.

faqs.question: How did he learn to check teaching by the Scriptures?
faqs.answer: He says when he was taught things different from how he was brought up, he went home and studied the scriptures to prove them wrong, and almost every time they were right.

faqs.question: Will false prophets do miracles, and can the elect be deceived?
faqs.answer: He says a time is coming when God will grant false prophets to do supernatural things, as with the sorcerers of Egypt, who could only do what God gave them authority to do. But he says it is impossible to deceive the followers of Christ: “they know him they know his book and they stand firm,” and they are still on earth: “No secret rapture.”

scriptures.text_nkjv: For false christs and false prophets will rise and show great signs and wonders to deceive, if possible, even the elect.

So Moses and Aaron went in to Pharaoh, and they did so, just as the LORD commanded. And Aaron cast down his rod before Pharaoh and before his servants, and it became a serpent. But Pharaoh also called the wise men and the sorcerers; so the magicians of Egypt, they also did in like manner with their enchantments. For every man threw down his rod, and they became serpents. But Aaron’s rod swallowed up their rods.

faqs.question: Is there a secret rapture?
faqs.answer: He says the elect cannot be deceived and they are still on earth: “No secret rapture.” He says nothing is secret about His coming, which everybody sees and hears.

faqs.question: Why is the coming of Jesus called supernatural?
faqs.answer: He says it is supernatural because when Christ comes everybody everywhere on earth sees Him, while normally we do not see what happens on the other side of the earth.

faqs.question: What kind of church will be on earth when He comes?
faqs.answer: He says the elect will be so strong that false prophets and miracles cannot move them from Jesus Christ, a glorious church without spot or wrinkle that overcomes the gates of hell.

scriptures.text_nkjv: that He might present her to Himself a glorious church, not having spot or wrinkle or any such thing, but that she should be holy and without blemish.

faqs.question: How can you tell if a teaching about the end time is scriptural?
faqs.answer: He says the scriptures always put everything in alignment, and “when it’s out of alignment. It’s not scripture.”

faqs.question: Is the seal of God the same as the baptism of the Holy Spirit?
faqs.answer: He says no: anyone who accepts Christ receives His Spirit and becomes the temple of God, while the baptism of the Holy Spirit is a baptism of power with gifts.

faqs.question: Is the kingdom of God here now or coming?
faqs.answer: He says Christ’s first message was that the kingdom of God is at hand: “it’s here it’s not coming it’s here,” and we are part of His kingdom with laws that protect and bless us.

faqs.question: Do we have to start out as mature Christians?
faqs.answer: He says you won’t start out a mature Christian, but God will finish the good work in your life, line upon line, and get you there: “that’s his promise.”

scriptures.text_nkjv: being confident of this very thing, that He who has begun a good work in you will complete it until the day of Jesus Christ;
